title: vLLM - UCM Pipeline Store
description: UCM observability dashboard - pipeline-store module. Part of a set; the other UCM dashboards (tag: ucm) are linked from the header.

panels.description: Cache-stage hit rate from counter ratio: hits / (hits + misses). If low, most loads are descending into the Posix tier.
panels.title: Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Fraction of load shards that missed the Cache buffer and had to descend to the backend (shard-level miss rate at load time).
panels.title: Cache Backend Submit Ratio (load)

panels.description: Average end-to-end Cache load task duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache Load Duration

panels.description: Average Cache load bandwidth. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache Load Bandwidth

panels.description: Time a Cache load task spent waiting for the backend tier to fill the buffer. Large values mean frequent Cache misses or slow backend. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache Load Backend Wait

panels.description: Cache load host-to-device copy duration on a synchronized stream. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache H2D Duration

panels.description: Average end-to-end Cache dump task duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache Dump Duration

panels.description: Average Cache dump bandwidth. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache Dump Bandwidth

panels.description: Cache dump device-to-host copy + stream sync duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Cache D2H Duration

panels.description: Posix-stage storage-to-host bandwidth (load direction). Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Posix S2H Bandwidth (read)

panels.description: Posix-stage host-to-storage bandwidth (dump direction). Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Posix H2S Bandwidth (write)

panels.description: Posix-stage S2H per-IO duration. Represents disk read latency. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Posix S2H Duration

panels.description: Posix-stage H2S per-IO duration. Represents disk write latency. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.
panels.title: Posix H2S Duration
Cache / Load Duration
panels.description: End-to-end Cache load task duration distribution. Bimodal here often indicates a mix of Cache hits (fast) and misses descending to Posix. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Load Bandwidth
panels.description: Effective Cache load bandwidth distribution. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Dump Duration
panels.description: Caller-felt Cache dump duration. Watch for convergence with Posix h2s duration -- back-pressure signal (see perf doc §3.4). -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Dump Bandwidth
panels.description: Effective Cache dump bandwidth distribution. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Load Backend Wait
panels.description: Time waiting for Posix to fill the buffer on a Cache miss. Spread and shift here drives total load latency. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / S2H Duration
panels.description: Per-IO storage read latency distribution. Bimodal often = OS page cache hits vs cold reads. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / H2S Duration
panels.description: Per-IO storage write latency distribution. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / S2H Bandwidth
panels.description: Storage read bandwidth distribution. Buckets are dense in 1-12 GB/s to resolve the typical operating range. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / H2S Bandwidth
panels.description: Storage write bandwidth distribution. Buckets dense in 1-12 GB/s. -- distribution shape over time, all workers aggregated.
